cert.ajustes_seguridad_cifrado_y_credenciales: Settings → Security → Encryption & credentials → Install a certificate → CA certificate.

cert.este_certificado_es_la_autoridad_raiz_lo: This certificate is PitWall’s local root authority. It is public (contains no private key) and only makes devices trust this server’s HTTPS on your network. Cross-check the SHA-256 fingerprint against the one under Settings → Local HTTPS if you want to be sure it is your PitWall’s.
cert.instala_este_certificado_en_el_dispositi: Install this certificate on the device so the driver-control QR scanner opens the camera WITHOUT the “connection not private” warning. Only needed once per device.

cert.luego_ajustes_general_informacion_ajuste: Then Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings and enable “PitWall Local CA”.
cert.no_es_imprescindible_sin_instalarlo_la_c: Not mandatory: without it, the camera still works by accepting the warning once. Installing the certificate just removes that warning.
cert.ve_a_ajustes_general_vpn_y_gestion_de: Go to Settings → General → VPN & Device Management → install the “PitWall Local CA” profile.

confirm.los_participantes_se_anaden_al_crear_cad: Participants are added when creating each heat group, not now.

database.al_subirla_no_cambia_nada_todavia_queda: Uploading changes nothing yet: it stays pending.
database.antes_se_guarda_sola_una_copia_de_los_da: The current data is backed up automatically first, in case you need to undo.
database.arrastra_aqui_el_archivo_db_o_pulsa_para: Drop the .db file here or click to choose it
database.arrastra_aqui_el_archivo_pwrace_o_pulsa_: Drop the .pwrace file here or click to choose it

database.esto_reemplazara_todos_los_datos_actuale: This will replace ALL current data the next time you open PitWall. Continue?
database.genera_un_archivo_pwrace_con_todo_equipo: Creates a .pwrace file with everything: teams, drivers, heats, laps, shifts, tires, inspections and pole.

database.hay_una_manga_en_marcha_importa_la_carre: A heat is running: import the race when it ends.

database.lo_que_hay_ahora_mismo_en_la_base_de_dat: What is in this PC's database right now.

ecosystem.activado_control_puede_enviarnos_tandas_: Enabled: Control can send us rounds over the network (with a PIN) and read per-round results. Disabled: any connection from Control on another network device is rejected. This machine and the allowlisted IPs in Settings are not affected.
ecosystem.controla_si_pitwall_control_puede_conect: Controls whether PitWall Control can connect to this Manager over the local network to send us information.
ecosystem.cuando_control_se_conecta_desde_otro: When Control connects from another device on the network, it has to enter this PIN.
ecosystem.sin_red_tambien_puedes_importar_una_tand: No network? You can also import a round by hand.

edit.activalos_para_poder_anotar_la_categoria: Turn them on to record each team’s or driver’s category/cup and car in the heat group. Optional: filling them in is not required. The category shows in the live view; both appear in the Excel.
edit.asignar_o_cambiar_el_escenario_reajusta_: Assigning or changing the scenario readjusts the lane count and starting sequence. Pending heats are regenerated on save.
edit.cada_piloto_se_identifica_por_qr_el_cont: Each driver scans a QR; the counter sums their minutes across ALL heats of the race.
edit.las_reglas_de_turnos_y_los_neumaticos_no: Driver-shift rules and tyre allowance cannot be changed: a heat of this race has already been run.
edit.las_tandas_pendientes_sin_mangas_corrida: Pending heats (no completed mangas) are regenerated automatically with the new order on save. Heats with completed mangas are kept.
edit.los_cruces_mas_rapidos_que_este_tiempo_s: Crossings faster than this are discarded as bounces. Empty = disabled. Applies from the next heat.
edit.no_se_puede_cambiar_el_escenario_la_carr: The scenario cannot be changed: the race already has recorded laps.
edit.orden_de_rotacion_de_salida_arrastra_par: Starting rotation order. Drag to reorder lanes and rests (💤). Count unchanged.
edit.pares_de_neumaticos_2_ruedas_que_se_sumi: Pairs of tyres (2 wheels) supplied to EACH team for the whole race; the same for all. It is the basis of the tyre-change control.

form.los_descansos_dsc_se_usan_cuando_una_car: Rest slots (DSC) apply when a race has more drivers than lanes. Drag them where you want the rest to happen within the rotation.
form.manten_el_raton_pulsado_y_arrastra_para_: Hold mouse and drag to auto-trace curves with many points

form.subir_foto_pon_una_imagen_cenital_de_fon: • "Upload photo" — drop an overhead image as background

settings.anade_el_subdominio_p_ej_directo_miclub_: add the subdomain (e.g. live.myclub.com) pointing at
settings.arrancar_el_tunel_automaticamente_con_pi: Start the tunnel automatically with PitWall
settings.basico_el_inicio_solo_muestra_entreno_li: Basic: home only shows free practice, sprint race, results, categories, scenarios and settings. Advanced: every shortcut. Saved instantly.
settings.cada_ds_300_controla_un_circuito_indepen: Each DS-300 controls one independent circuit. Lanes are numbered globally.
settings.cada_master_bart_p_ej_bart_track1_bart_t: Each BART Master (e.g. BART_TRACK1, BART_TRACK2…) is an independent device that must be paired separately — they don't share lanes with each other. Add one row per physical Master; lanes are numbered globally in list order.
settings.como_configurarlo_una_sola_vez: How to set it up (one time)
settings.como_prefieres_ver_la_informacion_de_la_: How you prefer to see race information.
settings.como_se_ordenan_tarjetas_y_filas_y_que_p: How cards and rows are ordered, and which position (P.x) each team or driver shows. The projected standings side panel does not change.
settings.cuenta_gratuita_con_tu_dominio_ya_anadid: (free account) with your domain already added to Cloudflare.
settings.dale_un_nombre_p_ej_el_del_club: give it a name (e.g. your club).
settings.del_conector_la_cadena_larga_que_empieza: from the connector (the long string starting with “eyJ…”) and paste it above.
settings.el_escaner_qr_del_control_de_pilotos_usa: The driver-control QR scanner uses the camera, which browsers only allow over HTTPS on phones/tablets connecting by IP. PitWall serves HTTPS with its own certificate, alongside normal HTTP.
settings.espera_de_cruces_tras_el_final_s: Wait for crossings after the end (s)
settings.filtro_anti_rebote_del_hardware_descarta: Hardware debounce: drops crossings faster than this
settings.genera_una_url_aleatoria_trycloudflare_c: Generates a random *.trycloudflare.com URL on start (changes every start). Great for testing or one-off events.
settings.genera_vueltas_aleatorias_ideal_para_pru: Generates random laps. Ideal for testing.
settings.guia_oficial_de_cloudflare_crear_un_tune: Official Cloudflare guide (create a remote tunnel)
settings.interface_tictacslot_cuentavueltas: TicTacSlot interface (lap counter) over USB, detected automatically.
settings.la_app_movil_de_tic_tac_slot_infolap_se_: The Tic Tac Slot Infolap mobile app connects to PitWall and receives live laps. Opens UDP :4441.
settings.la_coma_la_fraccion_de_vuelta_de_cada_co: The fraction (each car’s partial lap when the flag falls) is calculated automatically. Turn this on to fix it by hand, per lane, in the corrections screen of a finished heat; a corrected fraction wins tie-breaks on equal laps. Saved instantly.
settings.las_10_vueltas_que_muestra_cada_carril_e: The 10 laps each lane shows in the practice "With history" view. Saved instantly; an open practice picks it up on reload.
settings.las_cajas_deben_estar_direccionadas_en_o: Boxes must be addressed in order (1, 2, 3…) on the aggregator. 8N1, same as a standalone DS-300.
settings.los_cambios_se_aplican_al_pulsar_guardar: Changes apply when you press “Save & apply”.
settings.los_que_usan_todas_las_pantallas_cuando_: Used on every screen when there is no circuit or the circuit has no colors of its own (set them on each circuit). Saved instantly, without touching the timing connection.
settings.minimo_4_caracteres_si_se_olvida_arranca: At least 4 characters. If forgotten, start PitWall with PITWALL_DISABLE_PASSWORD=1 and set it again here.
settings.para_que_quien_no_conoce_el_programa_no_: So that people who do not know the program do not touch what they should not: asks for a password for System (Settings, Database, syncs, ecosystem, troubleshooting) and Catalog (Drivers, Teams, Cars, Categories, Scenarios), also on this machine and in the desktop app. Home, races, practice, results and live stay open.
settings.pitwall_disable_password_1_esta_puesto_a: PITWALL_DISABLE_PASSWORD=1 is set: no password is being asked right now.
settings.publica_el_directo_los_resultados_y_lap_: Publishes live, results and Lap via your club's own Cloudflare tunnel. App control stays blocked from outside.
settings.quien_puede_entrar_a_pitwall_desde_la_re: Who can reach PitWall from the venue network.
settings.registra_tramas_ds_300_crudas_cruces_de_: Logs raw DS-300 frames, lane crossings, manga events and errors under logs/debug/ (.jsonl + .log). One pair per manga.
settings.se_guarda_al_momento_sin_tocar_la_conexi: Saved instantly, without touching the timing connection.
settings.silencio_ms_entre_bytes_que_separa_dos_t: Silence (ms) between bytes that separates two frames. Default 75. Lower it if your DS chains frames fast.
settings.sin_el_el_navegador_avisa_una_vez_conexi: Without it the browser warns once (“not private → proceed”).
settings.solo_este_equipo_localhost_y_las_ips_de_: Only this machine (localhost) and the listed IPs. The mobile app and Infolap keep receiving live laps.
settings.tictac_explicacion: The TicTacSlot interface connects over USB and PitWall detects it automatically: just plug it in (if it is unplugged, it reattaches when reconnected). The device only sends crossings: it has no GO, pause or finish signal. "Serial port" is for the emulator or the hid-bridge.js bridge. On macOS it may ask for "Input Monitoring" permission.
settings.tiempo_durante_el_que_al_terminar_la_man: How long after the heat ends a car crossing the line still counts as a flag lap with its real time. On equal laps, whoever crossed first wins. 0 disables it (the lap is restored at the average time). Saved instantly; applies from the next heat.
settings.todas_lo_hace_accesible_por_cable_y_wifi: "All" makes it reachable on LAN and WiFi at once; pick one to limit it.
settings.un_aparato_agrupa_varias_cajas_ds_300_y_: A device aggregates several DS-300 boxes and delivers them over one COM port. PitWall separates boxes by their frame id (byte 4) and numbers lanes globally: box 1 → 1–8, box 2 → 9–16, and so on.
settings.uno_o_varios_ds_300_por_usb_rs_232: One or more DS units (300, 200, 030 or 080) via USB/RS-232.
settings.varias_cajas_ds_por_un_solo_puerto_com: Several DS boxes over one COM port.

shifts-live.anade_tiempo_a_un_piloto_que_corrio_pero: Add time to a driver who raced but was not checked in by QR.
shifts-live.apunta_la_camara_al_qr_del_piloto: Point the camera at the pilot QR
shifts-live.esta_vista_se_activa_cuando_hay_una_carr: This view activates when there is a championship race with a manga prepared or running.
shifts-live.no_se_admiten_cambios_de_piloto_en_los_m: No driver changes in the final minutes of the heat
shifts-live.ver_todas_las_tarjetas_de_una_vez_sin_pa: See all cards at once, no paging

shifts-report.no_hay_pilotos_inscritos_con_perfil_de_c: No enrolled drivers with a catalog profile.

show.cada_b_tanda_b_es_una_ronda_donde_los_pi: Each heat group is a round where pilots rotate through lanes following the order above. Add the first to start timing.
show.estimacion_al_final_de_la_carrera_no_sol: Estimate at the end of the race (not just the current heat).
show.media_por_vuelta_que_necesitas_para_alca: Lap pace needed to catch the car ahead
show.sale_en_el_inicio_y_recibe_el_go: Shown on home, receives the GO
show.salidas_de_pista_pit_stops_cambios_de_ne: Track exits / pit-stops / tire changes 🛞 for the WHOLE race
Track exits / pit-stops / tire changes 🛞 in this heat
show.tiempo_perdido_en_esas_salidas_pits_exce: Time lost on those exits/pits (excess over the race-wide clean average)
show.tienes_que_terminar_la_sesion_de_pole_po: You need to finish the Pole Position session before adding heats.
show.vueltas_respecto_al_de_delante_en_la_man: Laps behind the car ahead in this heat; if tied on laps, average pace difference

tanda-edit.esta_tanda_ya_tiene_mangas_iniciadas_sol: This round already has heats in progress. You can only rename — adding or removing participants is not allowed.
tanda-edit.guardar_cambios_se_regenerara_la_program: Save changes? The heat schedule will be regenerated.

tanda-new.el_carril_libre_va_cambiando_cada_manga_: the free lane changes every heat so everyone runs on the same lanes.
tanda-new.los_carriles_de_mayor_numero_quedan_siem: the highest-numbered lanes stay empty; nobody runs on them.
tanda-new.selecciona_un_equipo_de_la_izquierda_y_p: Select a team on the left and click a lane or rest (or drag it). Click an assigned one to free it.
tanda-new.si_hay_menos_participantes_que_carriles_: If there are fewer participants than lanes, what should happen with the free lanes?

teams.b_cabecera_obligatoria_b_columnas_recono: Header required. Recognized columns (free order): name (required), category, car, country (just the name — flag auto-added), notes, drivers (list separated by "|"). Each driver is looked up in the database by name: if it exists, linked to the team; if not, auto-created as bronze and shown in /drivers so you can adjust the category. Accepts "," or ";" as separator. Quote cells that contain commas.

training.equipos_o_pilotos_asignados_a_carriles_c: Teams or drivers assigned to lanes with automatic rotation after each heat.
training.registra_vueltas_por_carril_sin_estructu: Record laps per lane without team structure. Ideal for open sessions.

wizard.al_activarlos_al_inscribir_cada_equipo_o: When on, you can set each team’s or driver’s category/cup and car while signing them up (and edit them later from the heat group). Filling them in is not required.
wizard.anade_todos_los_equipos_con_sus_integran: Add all teams with their members.
wizard.anade_todos_los_pilotos_que_participaran: Add all drivers who will participate in qualifying and the race.
wizard.arrastra_los_elementos_para_ajustar_el_o: Drag items to manually adjust the order.
wizard.c_impares_dsc_despues_del_carril_2_c_par: Odd C: rest after lane 2 · Even C: rest after second-to-last
wizard.carrera_corta_cada_piloto_corre_por_su_c: Short race, each driver on their own.
wizard.deja_en_blanco_lo_que_no_quieras_control: Leave blank whatever you do not want to control. Each driver scans a QR and their minutes add up across all heats.
wizard.individual_desc: Each lane has one assigned driver
wizard.la_secuencia_debe_contener_cada_carril: The sequence must contain each lane exactly once (plus optional rest slots).
wizard.larga_duracion_por_equipos_con_turnos_de: Long race, by teams, with driver shifts and tyres.
wizard.lo_basico_de_la_carrera_los_participante: The race basics. Participants and lanes come next.
wizard.los_carriles_se_reparten_al_crear_la_tan: Lanes are assigned when creating the heat group.
wizard.los_tiempos_se_registran_durante_la_sesi: Times are recorded during the pole session.
wizard.mangas_seguidas_en_el_mismo_carril_las_v: Consecutive heats on the same lane; laps add up.
wizard.members_hint: All teams will have the same number of members
wizard.se_ve_junto_al_nombre_en_el_directo_y_sa: Shown next to the name in the live view and included in the Excel.
wizard.team_desc: Each lane has a team with multiple members
wizard.toca_un_equipo_del_catalogo_para_anadirl: 📋 Tap a catalog team to add it with its drivers. If it doesn't exist, add it manually below.
wizard.veces_que_se_corre_la_rotacion_completa_: Times the full lane rotation is run.
